scenes.tts: A drug leaves only a few percent of a channel's current. Does the neuron go quiet?
scenes.visual: Title card: Strong Nav1.8 Block, Still Firing. A nearly flat current trace beside a firing neuron.
scenes.narration: A drug leaves only a few percent of a channel's current. Does the neuron go quiet?

scenes.tts: N A V one point seven was the obvious target, and the compound tested here has not delivered.
scenes.caption: Nav1.7 was the obvious target, and the compound tested here has not delivered.
scenes.visual: The genetics flag over Nav1.7 beside a stalled drug-pipeline arrow.
scenes.narration: Nav1.7 was the obvious target, and the compound tested here has not delivered.

scenes.tts: One selective blocker was far more potent on half-inactivated channels than on resting ones. Nearly a thousandfold, produced by voltage alone.
scenes.visual: Two protocols on one channel: a holding voltage where channels are inactivated, and one at rest. On screen: 11 nM versus about 10 micromolar, with the ratio bar between them.
scenes.narration: One selective blocker was far more potent on half-inactivated channels than on resting ones. Nearly a thousandfold, produced by voltage alone.

scenes.tts: That is state dependence of block. It is not selectivity between channel subtypes.
scenes.visual: Two panels: same channel at two voltages, labelled state dependence; beside it, different subtypes, labelled selectivity, crossed out.
scenes.narration: That is state dependence of block. It is not selectivity between channel subtypes.

scenes.tts: In the summarized pharmacology the compound was only elevenfold selective over another subtype.
scenes.visual: A narrow selectivity margin drawn between two subtype bars. On screen: 11-fold over Nav1.2.
scenes.narration: In the summarized pharmacology the compound was only elevenfold selective over another subtype.

scenes.tts: In a trial in painful diabetic neuropathy it did not significantly improve weekly average pain.
scenes.visual: A trial schematic: drug and placebo arms, with the week-4 difference drawn as an estimate and its uncertainty range crossing zero, never as a flat zero. On screen: 135 participants; no statistically significant difference at week 4.
scenes.narration: In a trial in painful diabetic neuropathy it did not significantly improve weekly average pain.

scenes.tts: The healthy-volunteer study's authors proposed insufficient dose and inadequate access to the central nervous system. Those are candidate causes.
scenes.visual: Two candidate labels beside a question mark: dose, and access to the central nervous system. Tag: proposed in a separate healthy-volunteer study; candidates, not settled.
scenes.narration: The healthy-volunteer study's authors proposed insufficient dose and inadequate access to the central nervous system. Those are candidate causes.

scenes.tts: N A V one point eight went differently. Suzetrigine binds a site away from the pore and stabilizes the closed state.
scenes.caption: Nav1.8 went differently. Suzetrigine binds a site away from the pore and stabilizes the closed state.
scenes.visual: A channel with a drug bound at voltage-sensing domain 2, the pore drawn shut. Label: allosteric, closed-state stabilizer.
scenes.narration: Nav1.8 went differently. Suzetrigine binds a site away from the pore and stabilizes the closed state.

scenes.tts: It was highly selective across the human subtypes tested in a recombinant panel.
scenes.visual: A panel of subtype bars, the Nav1.8 bar far above the rest. Tag: recombinant panel.
scenes.narration: It was highly selective across the human subtypes tested in a recombinant panel.

scenes.tts: Selectivity in a recombinant panel is not tissue selectivity in a patient.
scenes.visual: The panel on one side, a patient outline on the other, with a crossed-out equals sign between them.
scenes.narration: Selectivity in a recombinant panel is not tissue selectivity in a patient.

scenes.tts: Two surgical trials, after abdominoplasty and after bunionectomy, summed each patient's pain relief over forty-eight hours.
scenes.caption: Two surgical trials, after abdominoplasty and after bunionectomy, summed each patient's pain relief over 48 hours.
scenes.visual: Two trial arms with patient counts on screen: 1,118 and 1,073; the SPID48 window drawn as 48 hours of ratings.
scenes.narration: Two surgical trials, after abdominoplasty and after bunionectomy, summed each patient's pain relief over 48 hours.

scenes.tts: Suzetrigine beat placebo in both. Neither trial demonstrated superiority over the opioid comparator.
scenes.visual: An outcome table rather than a bar chart: superior to placebo in both trials; superiority over hydrocodone with acetaminophen not demonstrated; the bunionectomy comparator analysis favouring the opioid. No equal heights drawn.
scenes.narration: Suzetrigine beat placebo in both. Neither trial demonstrated superiority over the opioid comparator.

scenes.tts: A failed superiority test is not equivalence, and one trial's comparator analysis ran the other way.
scenes.visual: The bunionectomy panel highlighted, with the comparator arm favoured and a tag: prespecified analysis.
scenes.narration: A failed superiority test is not equivalence, and one trial's comparator analysis ran the other way.

scenes.tts: Approval in the United States followed in January twenty twenty five, for moderate-to-severe acute pain in adults.
scenes.caption: Approval in the United States followed in January 2025, for moderate-to-severe acute pain in adults.
scenes.visual: A regulatory stamp dated January 2025, with the indication text beside the two surgical models.
scenes.narration: Approval in the United States followed in January 2025, for moderate-to-severe acute pain in adults.

scenes.tts: The two drug results came from different pain conditions. They are not a comparison of targets.
scenes.visual: The neuropathy trial and the surgical trials side by side, with a crossed-out versus sign between them.
scenes.narration: The two drug results came from different pain conditions. They are not a comparison of targets.

scenes.tts: Now the channel itself. A one-to-one model was fitted to the recombinant current at body temperature.
scenes.visual: The fitted concentration-response curve with its equation on screen and the dissociation constant marked.
scenes.narration: Now the channel itself. A one-to-one model was fitted to the recombinant current at body temperature.

scenes.tts: The temperature of the rig changes that fitted number by more than fivefold.
scenes.visual: Two fitted curves, one at 37 °C and one at 21 °C, with their constants on screen.
scenes.narration: The temperature of the rig changes that fitted number by more than fivefold.

scenes.tts: At a bath leaving only a few percent of that recombinant current, what does a human neuron do?
scenes.visual: The residual fraction at 10 nM marked on the curve, and an empty recording panel beside it.
scenes.narration: At a bath leaving only a few percent of that recombinant current, what does a human neuron do?

scenes.tts: Generally, it keeps firing. During depolarizing current injection, most tested neurons kept firing repetitively. Firing was generally reduced, but not eliminated.
scenes.visual: A control spike train beside a treated train, with the injected-current step drawn beneath both. Label: adult human sensory neurons at 37 degrees Celsius; typical, not universal.
scenes.narration: Generally, it keeps firing. During depolarizing current injection, most tested neurons kept firing repetitively. Firing was generally reduced, but not eliminated.

scenes.tts: The peak and the shoulder came down. Threshold and the initial upstroke were largely spared.
scenes.visual: One spike overlaid on its control: the peak lower and the shoulder reduced, the foot and threshold unchanged.
scenes.narration: The peak and the shoulder came down. Threshold and the initial upstroke were largely spared.

scenes.tts: The voltage-clamp analysis suggested two reasons. In many of these neurons the N A V one point eight current is very large. Near-complete block still leaves nanoampere-level current.
scenes.visual: A huge control current beside the residual sliver, with the sliver magnified and labelled nanoampere-level.
scenes.narration: The voltage-clamp analysis suggested two reasons. In many of these neurons the Nav1.8 current is very large. Near-complete block still leaves nanoampere-level current.
scenes.caption: The voltage-clamp analysis suggested two reasons. In many of these neurons the Nav1.8 current is very large. Near-complete block still leaves nanoampere-level current.

scenes.tts: And the other channel, N A V one point seven, dominates the initial spikes in these recordings.
scenes.caption: And the other channel, Nav1.7, dominates the initial spikes in these recordings.
scenes.visual: The first spikes of a train tinted as Nav1.7-dominated, with the Nav1.8 blocker label greyed out.
scenes.narration: And the other channel, Nav1.7, dominates the initial spikes in these recordings.

scenes.tts: So a channel-current calculation is not neuronal silence. And it is certainly not a dose.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: curve, then neuron, then patient. Three separate measurements.
scenes.narration: So a channel-current calculation is not neuronal silence. And it is certainly not a dose.
